scope: Full ost_visualizer scan; detailed review covers findings in the uncommitted production tree and directly affected Qt components.

removed_findings.action: Removed the method and rewrote tests through observable QHeaderView state and the workspace-backed controller.

removed_findings.action: Removed the method, the local width cache, and its resize callback.

removed_findings.action: Removed the single-item accessor and updated tests to use get_layers.

removed_findings.evidence: The field had three writes and no production read. _selection_projected_condition_uids owns highlight projection, while condition UIDs are derived from canonical selected takeoff UIDs per event.
removed_findings.action: Removed the field, resets, writes, and private-cache assertions.

removed_findings.evidence: All dynamic Summary rebuild callers use the paired begin_columns_update/end_columns_update signals so updates remain suppressed while the Qt model changes.

global_low_confidence_groups.evidence: Dataclass and TypedDict fields in MCP, collaboration, scene, mesh, and page-render DTOs are consumed through dataclass serialization, protocol output, or native bridges.
MCP tools, resources, and prompts are registered by OstMcpServer decorators/registries; direct Python references are intentionally absent.
ADOX schema, Windows Credential Manager, native renderer, PDF exporter, and cache attributes are read by COM, ctypes, nanobind, or native extensions.

second_pass_cleanup.classification: test accommodation that concealed incomplete production wiring
second_pass_cleanup.evidence: Every header-owning production dialog is backed by WorkspaceState.header_layouts, but MainWindow omitted the aggregate from FileOperationHandler and ComponentBuilder omitted it from PageSettingsBar. The optional fallback silently disabled persistence in Open Databases and the page-area picker.
second_pass_cleanup.action: Made the aggregate an explicit constructor dependency, wired both composition paths, and supplied isolated UI tests with a complete in-memory aggregate fixture.

second_pass_cleanup.classification: obsolete compatibility and duplicate conversion path
second_pass_cleanup.evidence: Current callers pass an integer identity or None; repository search found no caller or supported format producing the string NULL. The sentinel originated in the initial implementation and SQL/current UI contracts do not use it.
second_pass_cleanup.action: Removed the sentinel and routed Cover Sheet and direct job-status identifiers through one strict optional Access-integer converter.

second_pass_cleanup.evidence: Candidate validation parsed the same model position once while ordering UIDs and again immediately while building hit-test geometry.
second_pass_cleanup.action: Replaced it with one candidate snapshot carrying each validated UID and parsed model position.

second_pass_cleanup.evidence: The existing all-source projection test already covered identical UID sets. The removed test used two conditions, so it could not detect the historical single-condition placement side effect it claimed to guard.
second_pass_cleanup.action: Folded stable ordering and a real single-condition placement assertion into the existing all-source duplicate-projection workflow.

final_cleanup.classification: duplicated validation and weakened typed-state contract
final_cleanup.evidence: JsonWorkspaceStateRepository always constructs header layouts through HeaderLayoutState.from_dict, which already rejects non-list, non-string, empty-key, and duplicate orders. Production search found no alternate HeaderLayoutState producer with unvalidated order data.
final_cleanup.action: Kept structural validation at deserialization and reduced the controller to the view-specific wholly-unknown-schema check.

final_cleanup.evidence: A user header signal loaded WorkspaceState once for comparison and again through _stored_layout; the aggregate returns a deep copy on every read.
final_cleanup.action: Reused the already loaded typed layout for schema reconciliation and retained the equality guard before the single repository save.

final_cleanup.classification: incomplete aggregate fake and implementation-coupled assertion
final_cleanup.evidence: The fake exposed mutable state directly and counted update_state calls, unlike WorkspaceStateAggregate. The requirement under test is repository-write suppression.
final_cleanup.action: Replaced it with the real aggregate over a complete counting repository and asserted observable save operations.

final_cleanup.evidence: Recursive sibling sorting is observable through displayed project and bid labels; private role payloads are not part of the sorting contract.
final_cleanup.action: Rewrote the test to assert visible sibling order, parentage, and unchanged domain collections.

final_cleanup.evidence: The fake exposed a writable state attribute and retained caller-owned state objects, while WorkspaceStateAggregate exposes deep copies and persists updates through its repository contract.
final_cleanup.action: Replaced it with the real aggregate over a recording in-memory repository, initialized tests through the load contract, and asserted repository saves.

final_cleanup.evidence: The header test module already imports the shared complete workspace-state fixture, while the local fake bypassed repository persistence and deep-copy semantics.
final_cleanup.action: Removed the local fake and attached Summary headers with the shared real aggregate fixture.

final_cleanup.evidence: The Access transaction-depth fix now inspects the exception type, so the underscore prefix incorrectly claimed that the argument was unused.
final_cleanup.action: Renamed the parameter to exc without changing the transaction-boundary behavior.

final_cleanup.evidence: Repository callers and AGENTS.md confirm that SQL workspace reads run on the navigation worker, writes use the private queue, and complete bid snapshots must first project the file-loaded state.
final_cleanup.action: Retained concise docstrings describing these boundaries while leaving restatement-only UI docstrings removed.
